purpose: Base Craftas project listing wordmarks surrounded by three official characters

meguri.prompt: Preserve exact Utsupon, Mikke and Shirube identities. Transparent frame: raccoon lower left, fox lower right, owl upper center; empty central lower region for separately typeset wordmark. Exactly three characters, no text, no scenic backdrop.

totonoe.method: Deterministic SVG composition of existing official PNG assets; lossless WebP encoding; original wordmark preserved
totonoe.layout: Hakuto above the exact original wordmark, Tsugumo on the left, Mion on the right
